design.name: 当康
design.brief: A small chubby auspicious piglet-boar spirit (Dangkang of the Shan Hai Jing, omen of bumper harvests), a loyal companion: a round barrel body on four short sturdy legs with small split hooves, a short upturned snout, two small curved ivory tusks, big friendly dark eyes, floppy ears, warm wheat-gold fur carved in a few big clumps, a dark russet-brown ridge of bristles along the spine and dark brown lower legs (the dark colour block), a crest of golden rice-grain stalks growing from its forehead, and a red cord knot around its neck holding a round bronze coin charm that glows warm gold. Cheerful, brave and a little greedy; shown charging head first.
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing pose on all four legs
design.turnaround_pose: , legs straight and slightly apart so all four are clearly separate, head level and facing forward, mouth closed, the short curly tail visible behind; NO dust, sparkles or motion lines
design.turnaround_digits: each leg ends in a clearly split two-toed hoof; ears, rice crest and tail never cut off by the frame.
modeled: body with tusks and carved fur clumps
effects: coin pouch popping out of the ground
